visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A dense crowd of people is seen in a dark indoor concert hall. They have their arms raised, some holding smartphones to record the stage. The lighting is dim with bright, colorful stage lights in the background creating silhouettes. (2) A cartoon boy with blue hair and a gray t-shirt stands against a plain black background with text. He points his finger up as if explaining a concept. The lighting is flat and consistent. (3) A crowd at a sports stadium is shown. A young boy in a blue sports jersey jumps excitedly while others around him cheer and wave their arms in a bright outdoor environment under natural daylight. (4) A white round cartoon character with an angry expression appears, shouting with a yellow lightning bolt symbol nearby. The background is a plain dark gray. (5) The cartoon boy reappears, now holding a white piece of paper, gesturing with his hand as if reading or presenting information against a dark background with blue glowing lines. (6) Two purple stick figures holding pink objects move next to a yellow circular figure with blue eyes. The background is a gradient of dark purple and black with digital text overlays like "Anonymous". (7) The white cartoon character from before is shown again, this time with a microphone and an open-mouthed singing expression. Colorful stage light beams in blue, yellow, and red flash behind it. (8) A female singer in a white dress is on a stage with purple and white lighting. She interacts with a man in the crowd who is singing enthusiastically, his face captured in a medium close-up. (9) The cartoon boy is shown in a thinking pose with a hand on his chin. This transitions to a grainy cartoon clip of a crowd of angry-looking men in a stadium setting. (10) A close-up of a hand using a white computer mouse next to a keyboard. Below, a split screen shows a polite girl labeled "Reality" and an angry girl typing on a laptop labeled "Online". (11) A scene from an animation shows two small yellow creatures (minions), one wrapped in white bandages, in a dark stone room with a large, textured monster's tail visible.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 維他命C. [Slogan]: 為什麼演唱會觀眾會跟唱?. [Subtitle]: 早知道傷心總是難免的. (2) [Slogan]: 為什麼內向的人也跟唱?. [Subtitle]: 即使是平時性格內向的人. (3) [Logo]: 來源：伍佰Wu Bai. [Subtitle]: 在演唱會上也會大聲唱歌. (4) [Subtitle]: 在體育比賽中也會為運動員加油. (5) [Variety]: Why?!. [Subtitle]: 這是為什麼呢？. (6) [Subtitle]: 其實這是一種叫做「去個體化」的心理現象. [Slogan]: 去個體化. (7) [Variety]: 匿名. [Subtitle]: 當我們置身於人群之中，特別是在群體氛圍濃厚或匿名的情境中. (8) [Subtitle]: 個人意識會相對減弱，我們不再那麼在意旁人的目光. (9) [Subtitle]: 做起平時不敢做的事情來，因為好像「責任」被稀釋掉了. (10) [Variety]: 喔伊喔. (11) [Logo]: 來源：@chinatimesent. [Subtitle]: 演唱會就是這樣，燈光昏暗、氣氛爆棚. (12) [Subtitle]: 讓人不禁想放聲大唱. (13) [Subtitle]: 但這樣的心理狀態也有風險哦！. (14) [Subtitle]: 如果自我意識被完全沖淡，我們可能會失去對行為的責任感. (15) [Subtitle]: 比如，有些足球迷因為過度沉迷這種群體情緒，變得過於狂熱，甚至發展成「足球流氓」. (16) [Variety]: 現實. [Variety]: 線上. [Subtitle]: 還有，在社交平台上，因為匿名性太強. (17) [Subtitle]: 人們往往比現實中更容易說出攻擊性的言論. (18) [Subtitle]: 你有沒有在集體中做出平常絕不會做的舉動的經驗呢？.
